Class ChromaticGlyph.Plan

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client.ChromaticGlyph.Plan
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
Enclosing class:
ChromaticGlyph
public static final class ChromaticGlyph.Plan extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Captures one glyph pass's sampled transform and its four corner colors/alphas.

Whole-segment effects have already been applied by the font mixin; only local glyph transforms are sampled here. Glitch colors are sampled once per glyph rather than once per corner, so a flash remains visually coherent. Specialized background passes can override color, position and Matrix-cell appearance without replacing glyph textures.

  • Constructor Details

    • Plan

      public Plan(ChromaticText.Style style, float x, float y, float width, int original, float alpha, boolean shadow, Float passX, Float passY, Integer passColor, int matrixLayer, MatrixRainEffect.Cell matrixCell, float matrixScale, float matrixYOffset)
      Samples one glyph pass and makes the completed plan active on this render thread.
      Parameters:
      style - complete parsed style for this glyph
      x - original horizontal glyph position
      y - original vertical glyph position
      width - native glyph width in GUI pixels
      original - incoming foreground RGB before custom color selection
      alpha - incoming renderer alpha
      shadow - whether to darken RGB for a shadow pass
      passX - optional extra horizontal displacement, or null
      passY - optional extra vertical displacement, or null
      passColor - optional overriding RGB for outline/extrusion/halo passes
      matrixLayer - zero for normal foreground, negative for halo, positive for background cells
      matrixCell - sampled background symbol appearance, or null
      matrixScale - additional background-cell scale selected by grid fitting
      matrixYOffset - vertical background-cell displacement
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an effect sample is nonfinite

    • close

      public void close()
      Ends this plan's outstanding primitive and restores the previously active plan.

      Close once in reverse opening order on the render thread. The plan itself does not perform the owning Scope's broader context/graphics restoration.

      Specified by:
